blurb: Guests go on fishing charters targeting various fish species including yellowtail, whiteseabass, calico bass, bonito, barracuda, halibut, rockfish, sand bass, sheephead, and sculpin. Trips range from half day to full day, including fishing around Catalina Island and local waters. The service emphasizes sufficient fishing time with a minimum of 5 hours for half day trips.
